ambiguities: Games: both season files concatenated (2024-25 first), filtered to status_completed==True, then first row per game_id kept. Date = start_time_utc -> America/New_York calendar date.
Stints are restricted to kept games (stint games need a game date); stints with missing certified are treated as uncertified.
Event-to-stint assignment: stint with the largest start_order <= order in the same game, accepted only if order < end_order and the stint is certified; others ignored for on-court quantities.
On-court players: only home/away p1..p5 columns (home_n/away_n of 6 ignored); a player is listed per side with sec = stint seconds and poss = side poss.

Player oreb/dreb/pts: summed over all stint events with p1 == player regardless of the event's team_id; ast = made FG attempts (non-FT shooting_play & scoring_play) with p2 == player regardless of team. pts includes free throws (score_value when scoring_play).
own_miss / opp_miss / tm_fgm / tm_ast_fgm use event team_id == club / opponent; events with missing team_id count for neither.

Player EWM (half-life 25) is index-based over all of the player's stint games across clubs ordered (date, game_id, club); W(1) is the sum of weights. Row reads the state after the last stint game with date < row date; missing if none, making all ocas/prs/lcr columns missing.
League ratios use cumulative sums over all stint games dated strictly before the row date; if a ratio is missing the dependent column is missing (NaN propagation).

Candidates: prev = the club's last 5 team-games with date < d (from the club's team-games ordered by (date, game_id)); q = latest date among the player's stint games for T within prev. Conflict between the two clubs of a game resolved by larger q, then smaller club id.
Output sorted by (game_id, team); the pteam/opp columns are not written (not listed under Output).

assisted_three_passer_map: made threes = made FG attempts with score_value == 3 and p1 present, from all kept-game events. 'Label just before S' = the season label with the first year minus one (e.g. 2023-24 for 2024-25, not present in the data). Window uses the row game's season label.
atp: club_p is determined from the latest assisted made three passed by p across all shooters in the window (ordered by date, game_id, order); q_p counts over all shooters in the window.
atp_assisted3_share_pre written as n_s/tot even when n_s == 0 (value 0); top passer missing when n_s == 0.

creditable_rebound_pool: misses/team_reb/g_miss/g_treb computed over all events of the game; g_miss and g_treb are the sum of the two clubs' values (events with team_id not in the two clubs or missing are excluded). Team rebound = Offensive/Defensive Rebound with p1 missing. Club EWM half-life 40 is index-based over team-games; W(1) is the sum of weights.
crp: if either club (T or opponent) has no prior team-game, or either leakage ratio is missing, the dependent columns are missing (NaN propagation).
